reason: license does not allow a converted copy
details: The Aalto readme.txt (inside Keystrokes.zip) and the data page state only: "You are free to use this data for non-commercial use in your own research or projects with attribution to the authors"; redistribution of a converted copy is not granted. Also very large: 168,596 participants, about 136 million key presses, 16 GB unzipped (a converter would need hours on the PC). No consent-limit columns exist in the deposit (readme and metadata_participants.txt checked); paper venue/year/DOI match extra_studies.json (CHI 2018, 10.1145/3173574.3174220).
